review:
A pay-anywhere game with its own extra reel run by an ice queen – that reel hands out multipliers, and they can reach 500x in both the base game and the bonus. Having the multipliers on their own reel makes it really easy to see what's boosting what.

You can earn up to 14 free spins, with retriggers. Medium-high volatility, a 5,000x max and 97% RTP. Free spins about once every 250 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
